# iCE40 toolchain for the CI `fpga` job, installed with pip (YoWASP).
#
# The Ubuntu 24.04 toolchain is NOT used on purpose: nextpnr 0.6 places the
# design at 11.35 MHz, below the 12 MHz target, and then exits with an error.
# These wheels carry the same yosys/nextpnr the design is calibrated against
# (862/1280 LCs at 12.81 MHz), which keeps the area/timing budget check
# meaningful.  Versions are pinned for reproducibility; bump them deliberately
# when a new release is known to still fit.
#
# Used by actions/setup-python as the cache key (cache: pip).  These wheels are
# ~85 MB, so the cache saves a noticeable amount of time per run.
yowasp-yosys==0.70.0.0.post1259
yowasp-nextpnr-ice40==0.11.1.0.post826
